45327.meaning2: disciplinary code; precepts; training rules; lit. leading to freedom
45327.commentary: (VIN) pātimokkhan'ti ādim'etaṃ mukham'etaṃ pamukham'etaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ. tena vuccati pātimokkhan'ti. (KV) pātimokkhan'ti paatimokkhaṃ atipamokkhaṃ atiseṭṭhaṃ atiuttaman'ti attho.
45327.notes: There are numerous contested derivations of this word, both traditional and academic. Some of the more common ones are: - mukha, as in the entrance to all things wholesome. - pa mokkha, as in the foremost. - ati pa √muc, as in liberating. - pati √mokkh, as in the binding of a wound or the application of a medicine. - pāṭi 'sing', mukam 'face' from Tamil is a proposed non-Indo-Aryan origin.

examples.text: evaṃ, devā'ti kho so mah'āmatto rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa paṭissutvā āyasmato pilindavacchassa pañca ārāmikasatāni pādāsi, pāṭiyekko gāmo nivisi

45331.commentary: (MNa) aṭṭhamī-uposathassa hi paccuggaman'ānuggamanavasena sattamiyañ'ca navamiyañ'ca, cātuddasapannarasānaṃ paccuggaman'ānuggamanavasena terasiyañ'ca pāṭipade cā'ti ime divasā pāṭihārikapakkhā'ti veditabbā. tesu'pi uposathaṃ upavasi. (MNt) paccuggamananiggamanavasena uposathassa paṭiharaṇaṃ pāṭihāriyo, so eva pāṭihāriko, pakkho. ime divasā'ti ime cattāro divasā.

examples.text: imaṃ kho ahaṃ, kevaṭṭa, iddhipāṭihāriye ādīnavaṃ sampassamāno iddhipāṭihāriyena aṭṭīyāmi harāyāmi jigucchāmi
dhātiyo ayyaputto ekako'ti vegena sāṇiṃ ukkhipitvā anto pavisamānā bodhisattaṃ sayane pallaṅkena nisinnaṃ tañ'ca pāṭihāriyaṃ disvā gantvā rañño ārocayiṃsu

45333.commentary: (THIa) pāṭihāriyapakkhañ'cā'ti pariharaṇakapakkhañ'ca cātuddasīpañcadasīaṭṭhamīnaṃ yathākkamaṃ ādito antato vā pavesaniggamavasena uposathasīlassa pariharitabbapakkhañ'ca terasīpāṭipadasattamīnavamīsu cā'ti attho.

examples.text: cātuddasiṃ pañcadasiṃ, yā ca pakkhassa aṭṭhamī, pāṭihāriyapakkhañ'ca, aṭṭh'aṅgasusamāgataṃ.

45334.commentary: (THa) disvāna pāṭihīrānī'ti nāgarājadaman'ādīni aḍḍhuḍḍhasahassāni pāṭihāriyāni disvā. pāṭihīraṃ, pāṭiheraṃ, pāṭihāriyan'ti hi atthato ekaṃ, byañjanam'eva nānaṃ.

examples.text: disvāna pāṭihīrāni, gotamassa yasassino, na tāv'āhaṃ paṇipatiṃ, issāmānena vañcito.
na te dakaṃ āharanti, kaṭṭhaṃ vā aggidārukaṃ, sayañ'ca upasampannā, pāṭihīrass'idaṃ phalaṃ.

pāṭekka + aṃ
45337.commentary: (VINa) anupadaṃ nāma pāṭekkaṃ paṭṭhapetvā ekato osāpentī'ti therena, manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā'ti vutte sāmaṇero taṃ padaṃ apāpuṇitvā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā'ti dutiyapadaṃ ekato bhaṇati

examples.text: padaṃ nāma ekato paṭṭhapetvā ekato osāpenti. anupadaṃ nāma pāṭekkaṃ paṭṭhapetvā ekato osāpenti. anvakkharaṃ nāma, rūpaṃ aniccan'ti vuccamāno, run'ti opāteti. anubyañjanaṃ nāma rūpaṃ aniccan'ti vuccamāno, vedanā aniccā'ti saddaṃ nicchāreti.

[evam'eva kho māṇava evaṃ bhāvitāya mettāya (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī. dī. ni. 1.556) tathā'pi idha pāṭho'y'eva upamāya saṃsandiyamāno paripuṇṇo viya dissati]

taṃ tassa [ettha pana pāṭhabhedo n'atthi]

45347.commentary: (SNa) pāṇ'upetan'ti pāṇehi upetaṃ yāva me jīvitaṃ pavattati

examples.text: es'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ'ca bhikkhusaṅghañ'ca. upāsakaṃ maṃ, bhante, bhagavā dhāretu ajja't'agge pāṇ'upetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan'ti.
es'āhaṃ, bho ānanda, taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ'ca bhikkhusaṅghañ'ca. upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ ānando dhāretu ajja't'agge pāṇ'upetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan'ti.

n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekanikāyam'pi samanupassāmi evaṃ cittaṃ yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā, te'pi kho, bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā citten'eva cittitā, tehi'pi kho, bhikkhave, tiracchānagatehi pāṇehi cittaññ'eva cittataraṃ.
pāṇaṃ na haññe na c'adinnam'ādiye, musā na bhāse na ca majjapo siyā, abrahmacariyā virameyya methunā, rattiṃ na bhuñjeyya vikālabhojanaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso chappāṇake gahetvā nānāvisaye nānāgocare daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya.
yadā kho te, bhikkhave, chappāṇakā jhattā assu kilantā, atha kho yo nesaṃ pāṇakānaṃ balavataro assa tassa te anuvatteyyuṃ, anuvidhāyeyyuṃ vasaṃ gaccheyyuṃ.

45351.meaning1: little creature; small animal; worm; insect

examples.text: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ kākehi vā khajjamānaṃ kulalehi vā khajjamānaṃ gijjhehi vā khajjamānaṃ kaṅkehi vā khajjamānaṃ sunakhehi vā khajjamānaṃ byagghehi vā khajjamānaṃ dīpīhi vā khajjamānaṃ siṅgālehi vā khajjamānaṃ vividhehi vā pāṇakajātehi khajjamānaṃ
atha kho jīvako komārabhacco seṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ mañcake nipātetvā sambandhitvā sīsacchaviṃ uppāṭetvā sibbiniṃ vināmetvā dve pāṇake nīharitvā mahājanassa dassesi.

45352.meaning1: kind of little creature; type of small animal

examples.text: taṃ idh'eva kākā vā khādanti gijjhā vā khādanti kulalā vā khādanti sunakhā vā khādanti siṅgālā vā khādanti vividhā vā pāṇakajātā khādanti, yañ'ca khv'assa cittaṃ dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ… taṃ uddhagāmi hoti visesagāmi.
puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ kākehi vā khajjamānaṃ kulalehi vā khajjamānaṃ… vividhehi vā pāṇakajātehi khajjamānaṃ
evaṃ ce sattā jāneyyuṃ, dukkh'āyaṃ jātisambhavo, na pāṇo pāṇinaṃ haññe, pāṇaghātī hi socatī'ti.

45358.commentary: (VINa) pāṇabhūtesu saṃyamo'ti sattesu ca saṃyamo, avihiṃsanabhāvo sukho'ti attho.

examples.text: sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti
yo pāṇabhūtāni aheṭhayaṃ caraṃ, par'ūpavādā na karonti pāpaṃ, bhīruṃ pasaṃsanti na hi tattha sūraṃ, bhayā hi santo na karonti pāpan'ti.
pāṇabhū'ti pāṇabhūto. athavā tvam'evā'ti udāhu tvaṃ'y'eva.

45360.grammar: prp of pāṇaṃ atipātayanta, comp vb, trans (+acc)

examples.text: santi, gahapatayo, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino… pāṇam'atipātayato, adinnaṃ ādiyato, sandhiṃ chindato, nillopaṃ harato, ekāgārikaṃ karoto, paripanthe tiṭṭhato, paradāraṃ gacchato, musā bhaṇato, karoto na karīyati pāpaṃ.

45361.meaning2: causing another to kill a living being
45361.commentary: (DNa) pāṇam'atipātāpayato'ti pāṇaṃ hanantassa'pi hanāpentassa'pi. evaṃ sabbattha karaṇa-kāraṇa-vasen'eva attho veditabbo.

examples.text: karoto kho, mahārāja, kārayato, chindato chedāpayato, pacato pācāpayato socayato, socāpayato, kilamato kilamāpayato, phandato phandāpayato, pāṇam'atipātāpayato… karoto na karīyati pāpaṃ.

45362.commentary: (DHPa) yo pāṇamatipātetī'ti yo sāhatthik'ādīsu chasu payogesu ekapayogenā'pi parassa jīvit'indriyaṃ upacchindati.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, yo so puriso pāṇ'ātipātī rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayāsamayaṃ upādāya, katamo bahutaro samayo, yaṃ vā so pāṇam'atipāteti, yaṃ vā so pāṇaṃ n'ātipātetī'ti?
yo pāṇam'atipāteti, musāvādañ'ca bhāsati, loke adinnam'ādiyati, paradārañ'ca gacchati.

45363.meaning1: perceiving (something) as a being; regarding as a living being
45363.commentary: (VINa) pāṇe pāṇasaññī'ti antamaso mañcapīṭhaṃ sodhento maṅgulabījake'pi pāṇasaññī nikkāruṇikatāya taṃ bhindanto apaneti, pācittiyaṃ. tasmā evarūpesu ṭhānesu kāruññaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā appamattena vattaṃ kātabbaṃ. sesaṃ manussaviggahe vuttanayen'eva veditabbaṃ saddhiṃ samuṭṭhān'ādīhī'ti.

examples.text: appāṇe pāṇasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. appāṇe vemitako, āpatti dukkaṭassa. appāṇe appāṇasaññī, anāpatti.

45364.meaning1: dear as life; equal to life; beloved

examples.text: akkhehi dibbanti suraṃ pivanti, yant'itthiyo pāṇasamā paresaṃ, nihīnasevī na ca vuddhasevī, nihīyate kāḷapakkhe'va cando.

mahābandhanā mokkhaṃ karitvā caturāsītipāṇasahassāni mahāviduggā uddharitvā tejodhātuṃ samāpajjitvā sattatālaṃ vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā aññaṃ sattatālam'pi acciṃ abhinimminitvā pajjalitvā dhūmāyitvā mahāvane kūṭ'āgārasālāyaṃ paccuṭṭhāsiṃ.
uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsakajātikā bhavissāmā'ti
aṭṭhicchinnā pāṇaharā, gav'assa-dhana-hārino, raṭṭhaṃ vilumpamānānaṃ, tesam'pi hoti saṅgati, kasmā tumhākaṃ no siyā.

45371.meaning1: killing living beings; destruction of life

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, idh'assa puriso pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato adinn'ādānā paṭivirato kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato musāvādā paṭivirato pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato
idha cunda ekacco pāṇ'ātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato hoti nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī day'āpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī viharati

45372.meaning1: due to the destruction of life; on account of killing living beings

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco sahā'pi dukkhena sahā'pi domanassena pāṇ'ātipātī hoti, pāṇ'ātipātapaccayā ca dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti

ahañ'c'eva kho pana pāṇ'ātipātī assaṃ, attā'pi maṃ upavadeyya pāṇ'ātipātapaccayā, anuviccā'pi maṃ viññū garaheyyuṃ pāṇ'ātipātapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā pāṇ'ātipātapaccayā.

45373.meaning1: due to the destruction of life; on account of killing living beings

examples.text: katamāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti? yaṃ, gahapati, pāṇ'ātipātī pāṇ'ātipātappaccayā diṭṭhadhammikam'pi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, samparāyikam'pi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, cetasikam'pi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati.

45376.meaning1: due to the destruction of life; because of killing living beings

examples.text: tam'enaṃ rājāno gahetvā pāṇ'ātipātahetu hananti vā bandhanti vā pabbājenti vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā karonti. api nu tumhehi evarūpaṃ diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā'ti?

pāṇimhi ce vaṇo n'āssa, hareyya pāṇinā visaṃ, n'ābbaṇaṃ visam'anveti, n'atthi pāpaṃ akubbato.

45389.meaning1: sound of clapping; (comm) sound of hand cymbals

examples.text: kusāvatī, ānanda, rājadhānī dasahi saddehi avivittā ahosi divā c'eva rattiñ'ca, seyyath'idaṃ, hatthisaddena assasaddena rathasaddena bherisaddena mudiṅgasaddena vīṇāsaddena gītasaddena saṅkhasaddena sammasaddena pāṇitāḷasaddena asnātha pivatha khādathā'ti dasamena saddena.
na pāṇidaṇḍehi pan'ātha leḍḍunā, satthena vā maraṇavadhena vā pana, ubbādhanāya paritajjanāya vā, na heṭhayī janatam'aheṭhako ahu.

45391.meaning1: with a hand; by the palm

examples.text: bhaddakā vat'ime sunāparantakā manussā, subhaddakā vat'ime sunāparantakā manussā, yaṃ me na'y'ime pāṇinā pahāraṃ dentī'ti.
pāṇimhi ce vaṇo n'āssa, hareyya pāṇinā visaṃ, n'ābbaṇaṃ visam'anveti, n'atthi pāpaṃ akubbato.
ākoṭehī'ti āṇāpeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. sakiṃ pāṇippahāraṃ vā muggarappahāraṃ vā dinne nissaggiyaṃ hoti. nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.

45393.meaning1: as big as the palm; hand-sized
45393.commentary: (MNa) pāṇimattan'ti antomuṭṭhiyaṃ ṭhapanamattaṃ. (PVa) pāṇimattañ'ca coḷakan'ti ekahatthappamāṇaṃ coḷakhaṇḍan'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ pāṇimattaṃ pāsāṇaṃ gahetvā bhikkhū āmantesi, taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamo nu kho mahantataro, yo c'āyaṃ mayā paritto pāṇimatto pāsāṇo gahito, yo ca himavā pabbatarājā'ti?
sādhū'ti so paṭissutvā, sāriputto'nukampako, bhikkhūnaṃ ālopaṃ datvā, pāṇimattañ'ca coḷakaṃ, thālakassa ca pānīyaṃ, tassā dakkhiṇam'ādisi.
yato kho, bhaddāli, bhadro ass'ājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tam'enaṃ assadamako uttari vaṇṇiyañ'ca pāṇiyañ'ca anuppavecchati.
tañ'ce, āvuso, bhikkhuṃ pare aniṭṭhehi akantehi amanāpehi samudācaranti, pāṇisamphassena'pi leḍḍusamphassena'pi daṇḍasamphassena'pi satthasamphassena'pi.
so evaṃ pajānāti, tathābhūto kho ayaṃ kāyo yathābhūtasmiṃ kāye pāṇisamphassā'pi kamanti, leḍḍusamphassā'pi kamanti, daṇḍasamphassā'pi kamanti, satthasamphassā'pi kamanti.
kva naccaṃ, kva gītaṃ, kva vāditaṃ, kva akkhānaṃ, kva pāṇissaraṃ, kva kumbhathunan'ti, ime kho, gahapatiputta, cha ādīnavā samajj'ābhicaraṇe
yathā daṇḍena gopālo, gāvo pājeti gocaraṃ, evaṃ jarā ca maccu ca, āyuṃ pājenti pāṇinaṃ.
tasmā kareyya kalyāṇaṃ, nicayaṃ samparāyikaṃ, puññāni paralokasmiṃ, patiṭṭhā honti pāṇinan'ti.
na chattapāṇissa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
na satthapāṇissa agilānassa dhammo desetabbo. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca satthapāṇissa agilānassa dhammaṃ deseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
udakaṃ āsanena ca, āsanena saha pāṇīyaparibhojaṇīyaṃ udakaṭṭhapanaṃ kataṃ kiṃ? āsanena saha pāṇīyaparibhojaṇīyaṃ udakaṭṭhapanaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

examples.text: sugandhaṃ sītalaṃ kappaṃ, pasannamadhuraṃ subhaṃ, pāṇīyam'etaṃ bhagavā, paṭigaṇhātu'm'uttama.
